headline: FBM KLCI joins regional sell-off as oil price fears spark panic
summary: The FBM KLCI was on course to end the week 1.5 percent lower as oil prices returned to a two-month high. Fears of higher inflation and interest rates weighed on the market.
why: The FBM KLCI is Malaysia's benchmark stock index, and Malaysia is an oil and gas producer whose markets react to crude price swings.

impacts.name: FBM KLCI
impacts.why: The index is on course for a 1.5 percent weekly decline amid the regional sell-off.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Oil prices rose to a two-month high, reviving concerns about inflation and higher interest rates. The input says the KLCI joined a regional sell-off.
